stories.title: Trump asked Xi if Beijing wanted US weapons: a joke, a gambit or something more?

en.title: Trump asked Xi if Beijing wanted US weapons: a joke, a gambit or something more?
en.summary: US Ambassador David Perdue disclosed that Donald Trump asked President Xi Jinping about purchasing American weapons during Xi's recent White House visit. The State Department subsequently clarified that no such transaction would occur with China, described as Washington's principal strategic competitor.

stories.title: 航拍贵州荔波“艺术村”——洪江村

en.title: Aerial Photography of Guizhou Libo "Art Village"—Hongjiang Village
en.summary: Aerial photographs were taken of Hongjiang Village in Zhaoyang Town, Libo County, Qiannan Prefecture, Guizhou Province on September 28. The village is known as an art village.

stories.title: China lights up ‘super microscope’ hopes with world-leading electron gun beam

en.title: China lights up 'super microscope' hopes with world-leading electron gun beam
en.summary: China's Hefei Advanced Light Facility successfully fired its first electron beam in September using an advanced electron gun, marking progress toward building a powerful microscope facility. The technology could support research in areas including Alzheimer's disease and microchip development.

stories.title: 北京汽车集团有限公司原党委书记、董事长徐和谊一审被判死缓

en.title: Xu Heyi, Former Party Secretary and Chairman of Beijing Automotive Group, Sentenced to Death with Reprieve in First Instance
en.summary: Beijing's intermediate court convicted Xu Heyi, former leader of Beijing Automotive Group, of bribery and money laundering. He received a suspended death sentence with a two-year reprieve period, lifetime deprivation of political rights, and full confiscation of personal property, plus an additional two-year prison term for money laundering.

stories.title: 17 injured as minibus hits truck on Hong Kong highway during morning rush

en.title: 17 injured as minibus hits truck on Hong Kong highway during morning rush
en.summary: A minibus collided with a truck on Fanling Highway in Hong Kong's New Territories during Monday morning rush hour, injuring 17 people. The minibus failed to brake in time and struck the slowed truck near Choi Yuen Estate.

stories.title: 北京延庆“超山”挑战赛举行 近百名户外爱好者参与

en.title: Beijing Yanqing "Superhill" Challenge Race held with nearly 100 outdoor enthusiasts participating
en.summary: Nearly 100 outdoor sports enthusiasts gathered in Yanqing, Beijing for the 2026 Superhill Challenge Race at Yudu Mountain scenic area. Participants completed cycling climbs, open water swimming, and trail running events.

stories.title: 比预售再降2万 第二代家庭旗舰奕境X9正式上市，限时优惠价27.98万元起

en.title: Second-generation family flagship Yijing X9 officially launched with limited-time preferential price starting at 279,800 yuan
en.summary: The Yijing X9, a family flagship car developed through Dongfeng and Huawei collaboration, officially launched on September 24 with four models. Limited-time pricing starts at 279,800 yuan with combined benefit value up to 1 million yuan.

stories.title: High Court discharges jury in Abby Choi murder trial over sick juror, causing delay

en.title: High Court discharges jury in Abby Choi murder trial over sick juror, causing delay
en.summary: The Hong Kong High Court discharged a newly formed jury in the murder trial of socialite Abby Choi after a juror requested to be excused for health reasons. A new jury panel will be empanelled to continue the proceedings.

stories.title: 非遗聚匠心 工博促交融——铁西区文化市集开启双节同心盛宴

en.title: Intangible Heritage Gathers Craftsmanship, Industrial Expo Promotes Integration—Tiexi District Cultural Market Opens Dual Festival Celebration
en.summary: Tiexi District launched a cultural market event at the Industrial Museum on September 25, combining industrial heritage with ethnic unity activities. The initiative showcases the district's industrial foundation and cultural integration among ethnic groups during the national holidays.

stories.title: “走基层、看统战”媒体记者、网络大V济宁行采风活动举行

en.title: "Visiting Grassroots, Observing United Front" Media Reporters and Online Influencers Visit Jining
en.summary: From September 21 to 23, provincial united front officials organized media journalists and internet influencers to visit Jining for a grassroots observation activity. The trip aimed to promote united front stories and messaging across media platforms.

stories.title: 辽宁建筑职业学院赴牛河梁遗址开展主题研学实践活动

en.title: Liaoning Architectural Vocational College Conducts Thematic Research Study at Niuheliang Ruins
en.summary: On September 23, Liaoning Architectural Vocational College organized 40 students from 21 ethnic minorities to visit the Niuheliang Hongshan culture site. The group explored Chinese civilization heritage while celebrating the 77th anniversary of the People's Republic of China.

stories.title: 大连市举办港澳台侨迎中秋联谊活动

en.title: Dalian Holds Mid-Autumn Festival Gathering for Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and Overseas Chinese Representatives
en.summary: Dalian's united front department hosted a mid-autumn festival gathering on September 24 for representatives from Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and overseas Chinese communities. Over 50 representatives and Taiwan residents in Dalian attended the event.

stories.title: China fund managers warn of premium risks as fresh quotas fail to ease demand

en.title: China fund managers warn of premium risks as fresh quotas fail to ease demand
en.summary: Chinese mutual funds investing in US stocks have issued warnings about risks from substantial premiums to net asset values, as demand for US equities remains high despite Beijing's expanded outbound investment quotas.

stories.title: Strategic allocation to Asia fixed income

en.title: Strategic allocation to Asia fixed income
en.summary: Asian fixed income markets offer diversification opportunities for investors seeking to broaden portfolio exposure amid elevated global uncertainty, high inflation, and unclear monetary policy trajectories.

stories.title: Italy attracts wealthy Chinese property buyers with food, fashion – and flat tax

en.title: Italy attracts wealthy Chinese property buyers with food, fashion – and flat tax
en.summary: Italy's flat tax regime, which allows foreign residents to pay a fixed annual amount on overseas income, is attracting growing interest from wealthy mainland Chinese and Hong Kong property investors seeking high quality of life and tax benefits.

en.title: Mapping Biology's Next Frontier
en.summary: Liu Wei, an experienced technology investor who previously backed over 400 early-stage companies including more than 50 AI life sciences ventures, has transitioned from investor to founder with his new company BioMap.

stories.title: How Beijing is neutralising Washington’s sanctions machine

en.title: How Beijing is neutralising Washington's sanctions machine
en.summary: The article discusses Beijing's strategies to counter U.S. sanctions, set against a backdrop of ongoing geopolitical tensions including statements about Iran and Venezuela made by the U.S. president at the United Nations.
